fullPassage: Our homes aren't just ecosystems, they're unique ones, hosting species that are adapted to indoor environments and pushing evolution in new directions. Indoor microbes, insects, and rats have all evolved the ability to survive our chemical attacks, developing resistance to antibacterials, insecticides, and poisons. German cockroaches are known to have developed a distaste for glucose, which is commonly used as bait in roach traps. Some indoor insects, which have fewer opportunities to feed than their outdoor counterparts, seem to have developed the ability to survive when food is limited. Dunn and other ecologists have suggested that as the planet becomes more developed and more urban, more species will evolve the traits they need to thrive indoors. Over a long enough time period, indoor living could drive our evolution, too. Perhaps my indoorsy self represents the future of humanity.

questions.passage: Indoor microbes, insects, and rats have all evolved the ability to survive our chemical attacks, __________ (develop) resistance to antibacterials, insecticides, and poisons.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 develop(발달시키다)을 분사구문 형태 developing으로 바꿉니다. 앞 문장의 주어(실내 미생물·곤충·쥐)가 저항성을 '발달시키면서'라는 능동의 동시 동작을 나타내므로 현재분사 developing이 맞아요. '..., developing resistance(저항성을 키우면서)'가 됩니다.
det.tip: 분사구문은 주어가 직접 '하면서'(능동)일 때 -ing. develop → developing

questions.passage: Some indoor insects, which have fewer opportunities to feed than their outdoor counterparts, seem to have developed the ability to survive when food is __________ (limit).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 limit(제한하다)을 be동사(is) 뒤에서 수동의 의미를 갖는 과거분사 limited로 바꿉니다. 먹이가 '제한되는(당하는)' 것이므로 'food is limited(먹이가 제한될 때)'가 자연스러워요. be동사 뒤에는 과거분사가 와서 수동태를 이룹니다.
det.tip: be동사 + 과거분사 = 수동태(~되다). limit → limited (food is limited)

questions.passage: Our homes aren't just ecosystems, they're unique ones, hosting species that are adapted to indoor environments and __________. Indoor microbes, insects, and rats have all evolved the ability to survive our chemical attacks, developing resistance to antibacterials, insecticides, and poisons. German cockroaches are known to have developed a distaste for glucose, which is commonly used as bait in roach traps. Some indoor insects, which have fewer opportunities to feed than their outdoor counterparts, seem to have developed the ability to survive when food is limited. Dunn and other ecologists have suggested that as the planet becomes more developed and more urban, more species will evolve the traits they need to thrive indoors. Over a long enough time period, indoor living could drive our evolution, too. Perhaps my indoorsy self represents the future of humanity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 실내 환경에 적응한 종들을 품으며 진화를 새로운 방향으로 밀어붙인다
det.analysis:
❌ ① cleaning the air that we breathe: 본문에 없는 내용
❌ ② reducing the number of indoor pests: 글은 실내 생물이 늘고 진화한다는 취지로 반대
❌ ③ copying their outdoor relatives: 실내 종은 야외와 다르게 진화하므로 반대
✅ ④ pushing evolution in new directions: 실내에 적응한 종을 품으며 진화를 새로운 방향으로 이끈다는 글의 도입 주제 ←정답
det.tip: adapted to indoor environments and ______ → pushing evolution in new directions (진화를 새 방향으로 밀어붙이다)

ch: cleaning the air that we breathe
reducing the number of indoor pests

questions.passage: Our homes aren't just ecosystems, they're unique ones, hosting species that are adapted to indoor environments and pushing evolution in new directions. Indoor microbes, insects, and rats have all evolved the ability to survive our chemical attacks, developing resistance to antibacterials, insecticides, and poisons. German cockroaches are known to have developed a distaste for glucose, which is commonly used as bait in roach traps. Some indoor insects, which have fewer opportunities to feed than their outdoor counterparts, seem to have developed the ability to survive when food is limited. Dunn and other ecologists have suggested that as the planet becomes more developed and more urban, more species will evolve the traits they need to thrive indoors. Over a long enough time period, indoor living could __________, too. Perhaps my indoorsy self represents the future of humanity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 충분히 긴 시간이 지나면 실내 생활이 우리의 진화도 이끌 수 있다
det.analysis:
✅ ① drive our evolution: 실내 종뿐 아니라 인간도 실내 생활로 진화가 '이끌릴' 수 있다는 글의 결론적 확장 ←정답
❌ ② disappear from our cities: 본문 취지와 반대
❌ ③ stop all natural change: 진화가 계속된다는 흐름과 반대
❌ ④ depend on outdoor food: 실내 생활을 말하는 문맥과 다름
det.tip: indoor living could ______, too → drive our evolution (우리의 진화를 이끌다)
